text: Reports from Iowa are that the Army’s mitigation efforts have far exceeded expectations.
zh: 白宫：称爱荷华方面的消息显示，陆军的缓解措施效果远超预期。

text: @USOCC and the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau announce dollar thresholds for smaller loan exemption from appraisal requirements for higher-priced mortgage loans.
zh: 美联储：与货币监理署、消费者金融保护局共同公布高价抵押贷款中较小贷款可豁免评估的美元门槛。

text: and the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau announce dollar thresholds for applicability of truth in lending and consumer leasing rules for consumer credit and lease transactions.
zh: 美联储：与消费者金融保护局共同公布诚实借贷和消费者租赁规则的适用美元门槛。

text: SpaceX is building the infrastructure of the future and working to make life multiplanetary. We believe ownership of the company creating these systems should extend to the next generation of Americans. Today, we are committing one SpaceX share to millions of American children
zh: SpaceX：宣布向数百万美国儿童各赠一股公司股票，认为打造多行星生存基础设施的公司所有权应延伸到下一代美国人。

text: Read about economic conditions in Reserve Bank Districts in the #BeigeBook.
zh: 美联储：已发布最新《褐皮书》，介绍各储备区经济状况。

text: BIG NEWS! We have a whole new look at Dimorphos, the first asteroid humans have ever moved. @ESA_Hera mission has captured Dimorphos completing a full orbit around its larger companion, Didymos. Look closely and you will see the impact site come into view, and Dimorphos
zh: 欧空局：赫拉探测器拍到迪莫弗斯绕伴星迪迪莫斯运行完整一圈的新图像，可看到撞击点；这是人类首次移动过的小行星。

text: Teams encapsulated the Cygnus XL spacecraft earlier this week ahead of Falcon 9’s launch of @northropgrumman's commercial resupply mission to the @Space_Station. Liftoff is targeted for 10:47 a.m. ET on Sunday, November 29.
zh: SpaceX：已完成 Cygnus XL 整流罩封装，猎鹰9号计划于11月29日周日美东时间上午10:47发射，为诺格执行国际空间站商业补给任务。

text: We’re now testing Private Inference, our latest offering as part of OpenAI Private Intelligence, with a small group of customers. Stronger privacy protections will make frontier AI useful for a lot more work, and business privacy is important for a healthy ecosystem. Reach out
zh: 阿尔特曼：OpenAI 正在小范围客户中测试 Private Inference（私有推理），作为 Private Intelligence 的最新服务，以加强企业隐私保护。

text: Our supercompute site in Cochise County has been designed with Arizona in mind: no gas plant, no industrial water use, and a dry-cooling closed-loop water system. SpaceX will also invest $50B+ into the area, bringing 1,000 local permanent jobs and up to 5,500 construction jobs to
zh: SpaceX：科奇斯县超算中心按亚利桑那条件设计，不用燃气电厂、不取工业用水，并采用干冷闭式循环；还将向当地投资逾500亿美元，带来约1000个长期岗位和最多5500个建筑岗位。

text: We recently migrated our Messages API from Python to Rust. On our engineering blog, we share how we used the existing service to verify the new one, with teams of Claude agents tracking down and fixing differences between the two versions.
zh: Anthropic：已将 Messages API 从 Python 迁到 Rust，并在工程博客介绍如何用原服务校验新服务、由多组 Claude 智能体排查两边差异。

text: NEW: U.S. Economy Grows FASTER THAN EXPECTED in Q3. HUGE.
zh: 白宫：称美国经济第三季度增速快于预期。

text: Speech by Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman on modernizing banking supervision: a shared agenda for the Americas.
zh: 美联储：监管副主席鲍曼发表演讲，谈推进美洲银行监管现代化的共同议程。

text: Impressive work by Google — quoting @sundarpichai: Neon set a new Day-1 usage record on our paid APIs and @Antigravity tokens/day are ⬆️ 82% since Argon launched (only) 6 weeks ago.
zh: 马斯克：称赞谷歌工作出色，并转引皮查伊称 Neon 上线首日创下付费 API 用量新高，Antigravity 日均 token 较 Argon 发布六周以来上升 82%。

text: Starlink is now approved in 30 of 54 countries in Africa!
zh: 马斯克：Starlink 现已在非洲 54 国中的 30 国获批。

text: New Anthropic Fellows research: Returning to the neuron basis for interpretability. Understanding what’s happening inside an AI model helps to make it safer. One obvious place to look is its neurons, or the simple units it’s built from. Early interpretability work did just that,
zh: Anthropic：新研究主张回到神经元层面做可解释性，以便更好理解模型内部并提升安全性。

text: We've decided on key design features and mission details for Space Reactor-1 Freedom, the first fission-powered spacecraft to travel beyond Earth orbit. Set to launch in 2028, SR-1 Freedom will demonstrate nuclear electric propulsion in deep space.
zh: NASA：已确定深空核电推进试验船 Space Reactor-1 Freedom 的关键设计，计划 2028 年发射，将成为首个飞出地球轨道的裂变动力航天器。

text: Falcon 9 launches USSF-266 to orbit from pad 4E in California
zh: SpaceX：猎鹰 9 号已从加州 4E 发射台将 USSF-266 送入轨道。

text: New Anthropic research: When an AI agent can escape its sandbox, will it choose to? Our new evaluation, Siren, gives Claude routine tasks in intentionally weakened sandboxes, with something useful to the task left outside of the sandbox. Across 1,700+ scenarios built to tempt
zh: Anthropic：新评估项目 Siren 在故意削弱的沙箱中测试智能体，看它是否会为完成任务而逃离；共设计 1700 多个场景。

text: We’re sharing a new preprint showing wet lab validation of intrinsic protein design capabilities of the GPT-6 family of models. Our models can design new protein shapes and sequences using reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models to generate them.
zh: OpenAI：预印本论文显示，GPT-6 系列模型可仅靠推理和代码设计新的蛋白质形状与序列，并已通过湿实验验证，无需调用专门的生物学模型。

text: As part of a coordinated, whole-of-government effort, NASA has rapidly mobilized specialized research aircraft, space-based observation capabilities, and scientific personnel to support ongoing efforts at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa. NASA stands ready to
zh: NASA：已迅速调集专项科研飞机、卫星观测能力和科研人员，支援艾奥瓦州米德尔顿陆军弹药厂的相关工作。

text: Neon set a new Day-1 usage record on our paid APIs and @Antigravity tokens/day are ⬆️ 82% since Argon launched (only) 6 weeks ago. It's been great to see the reception and thanks for all the model feedback including areas to improve - huge thanks to the teams across
zh: 皮查伊：Neon 上线首日刷新付费 API 用量纪录；自 Argon 发布仅 6 周以来，Antigravity 每日 token 用量上升 82%。

text: Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond (@canvrno) and Ethan Byrd (@itsjustemail), independently found signals that could point to planets around distant stars. They knew you didn't need your own telescope for this kind of hunt. Kevin used Codex and Ethan used Astra to search public
zh: OpenAI：两名业余天文爱好者分别用 Codex 和 Astra 在公开数据中发现可能指向系外行星的信号。

text: The Federal Reserve has revised its indexes of industrial production, capacity, and utilization using benchmark data. Revisions to manufacturing production, capacity growth, and utilization are modest. #FedData (1/3)
zh: 美联储：已用基准数据修订工业生产、产能和产能利用率指数，制造业相关修订幅度不大。

text: A home away from home. We're building a Moon Base, where astronauts will live, work, and explore the lunar surface. Learn how @NASAMoonBase will be built and how it'll prepare us for future missions:
zh: NASA：正在建设月球基地，供航天员在月面生活、工作与探索，并为后续任务做准备。

text: Gas prices are falling as drivers hit the road for Thanksgiving.
zh: 白宫：感恩节出行期间，汽油价格正在下降。

text: The largest anti-scam enforcement surge in HISTORY. @TheJusticeDept is delivering on President Trump's directive: a government-wide crackdown on scams, fraud, and predatory schemes that harm Americans.
zh: 白宫：司法部正落实总统指示，开展据称史上最大规模的反诈骗执法行动。

text: Falcon 9’s first stage lands on the Of Course I Still Love You droneship
zh: SpaceX：猎鹰 9 号一级火箭已在无人飞船 Of Course I Still Love You 上着陆。

text: Real economic value, right here in Europe. ESA’s existing exploration activities are estimated to generate around €2.8 billion in GDP across Europe. That’s impact that starts in space but reaches far beyond it. And that’s why we’re boosting European space exploration.
zh: 欧空局：现有太空探索活动估计可为欧洲带来约 28 亿欧元 GDP。

text: Rocket launch today! 🚀 Tune in now to watch Ariane 6 lift off live from French Guiana, carrying 36 @AmazonLeo satellites. @ESA_transport @Arianespace @ArianeGroup
zh: 欧空局：阿里安6号今天将在法属圭亚那发射，搭载36颗亚马逊Leo卫星，发射直播已开启。

text: LIVE: An uncrewed Progress cargo spacecraft carrying food, fuel, and supplies is about to lift off on a two-day journey to the @Space_Station. Launch is scheduled for 5:17am ET (1017 UTC).
zh: NASA：无人进步号货运飞船计划于北京时间18:17发射，携带食品、燃料等补给，飞行两天前往国际空间站。

text:
Far too often, capital sentences are delayed for years, if not decades, stalling the justice the victims’ families deserve.

Today, President Trump signed a Memorandum to pursue capital punishment for heinous federal crimes & expedite the enforcement of capital sentences.
zh: 白宫：特朗普总统签署备忘录，要求对严重联邦重罪推进死刑并加快死刑执行。
